evidence: Matches the P2P label and directly alters peer address sampling in src/addrman.cpp.
rationale: Fixes a severe statistical bias in addrman bucket sampling that skews peer connection selection. The PR description shows that sequentially scanning from a random slot causes extreme distribution skews (e.g., '95.3% versus 4.7% in a two-entry bucket'), directly undermining uniform peer selection and eclipse resistance.
